'''Skin-gloves''' were a type of [[Glove/Legends|glove]] available during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. During the [[Battle of Drongar]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] surgeon [[Jos Vondar]] wore skin-gloves while operating on wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on at least two different occasions. Once each surgery was completed, he would remove the gloves.

==Behind the scenes==
Skin-gloves first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]] by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]], published in [[2004]].
